title: Report each bot style's VPIP, PFR and aggression against its band
description:
As a learner, I want each bot style's measured play checked against its target band, so that the opponents I practise against stay recognisable as the strategy code changes.

Adds `--check-styles` to the playtest CLI (REQ-062.1). Over the run, each style's VPIP, PFR and aggression are computed with the shared style-stat functions (E07-S08); aggression uses the REQ-045.3 definition, flop, turn and river actions only. Bands (inclusive): TAG VPIP 18-26%, PFR 14-22%, aggression 45-65%; Calling station 45-65%, 3-10%, 10-25%; Maniac 50-75%, 35-60%, 65-85%; Rock 8-15%, 6-12%, 35-55%. This story builds the reporting and the pass/fail check; tuning the style files into the bands is E06-S16 (TAG, Rock) and E06-S17 (Calling station, Maniac). The run also reports action counts for each spot type a style marks as mixed (REQ-028.3).

## Requirements covered
- REQ-027 (Must): Measurable style profiles — In headless 6-max playtests of 100,000 hands with the Mixed line-up, each bot style's measured statistics shall fall inside its target band.
- REQ-028 (Must): Reproducible mixed decisions — Where a bot's style gives more than one action a non-zero probability, the bot shall pick among them using a random generator derived from the hand's replay code, so that replaying a hand reproduces every bot decision.
- REQ-062 (Must): Headless playtest CLI — The project shall provide a command-line playtest runner that plays seeded bot-only hands with the production engine, checks invariants after every action and reports results.

Covers: REQ-027, REQ-028, REQ-062

Plan key: E06-S09 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given any playtest run, When it reports, Then it prints each style's VPIP, PFR and aggression to one decimal place, computed with the shared style-stat functions [REQ-062.3, REQ-027.5]

Given a test style file that moves one style's stat outside its band, When the playtest runs with `--check-styles`, Then it prints the style, stat, measured value and band and exits non-zero; a value exactly on a band edge passes [REQ-027.5, REQ-062.1]

Given a style whose actions in a run are 2 preflop raises, 3 postflop bets, 1 postflop raise and 4 postflop calls, When its aggression is reported, Then it is 50.0% because preflop actions are excluded [REQ-027.6]

Given a run with `--check-styles`, When it reports, Then it lists the action counts for every spot type each style marks as mixed and exits non-zero if any of those spot types used only one action [REQ-028.3]
Given a test style file whose measured stats are all inside its bands, When the playtest runs with `--check-styles`, Then it prints each stat with its band and exits 0 [REQ-027.5]

Given aggression is measured per style, When the report runs, Then it is measured after TASK-7.8 (postflop value betting) in mixed line-ups — a lone Maniac among TAGs reads 100% today because no bot bets postflop (TASK-6.4 finding)
Given the Rock seated with a Maniac at the table, When its VPIP and PFR are reported, Then they are re-measured against the 8–15% / 6–12% band (TASK-6.5 prototype: 9.9% / 8.3%, close to the floors)

Given `npm run playtest -- --hands 100000 --lineup mixed --size 6 --check-styles` with seeds 42, 7 and 1234, When it completes, Then TAG and Rock lines report inside their bands (TASK-6.16 tuned the Rock's postflop value bar to 75%)

Given `npm run playtest -- --hands 100000 --lineup mixed --size 6 --check-styles` with seeds 42, 7 and 1234, When it completes, Then all four styles (TAG, Rock, Calling station, Maniac) report inside their bands and the command exits 0 (TASK-6.17 tuning)
Given the 100k --check-styles run, When CI is set up, Then it runs in a nightly or on-demand workflow (deferred DoD#1 of TASK-6.17)
Given --check-styles, When it measures VPIP, PFR and aggression, Then it uses styleStats/styleCounts from src/stats/style-stats.ts (TASK-7.12), not a separate counter
